components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action of a view, such as "Cargar métricas".
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 8px); font: 500 0.875rem/1.25rem Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus-ring, #2b7fd4); outline-offset: 0; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-action-primary-bg, #a8d6ff); color: var(--color-text-default, #111827); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-action-primary-bg-hover, #8cc7ff); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: var(--color-action-disabled-bg, #e5e7eb); color: var(--color-text-disabled, #9ca3af); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 8px); font: 500 0.875rem/1.25rem Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus-ring, #2b7fd4); outline-offset: 0; } .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--color-text-default, #111827); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--color-action-subtle-bg-hover, #eef6ff); }

components.name: Metric Card
components.description: One indicator with its title, value and change vs. the previous year.
components.html:
Familias alcanzadas

1.284

+4,0 % vs. año anterior
components.css: .ds-metric { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; min-width: 240px; padding: 20px; background: var(--color-bg-surface, #ffffff); border: 1px solid var(--color-border-default, #e5e7eb); border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 12px); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-metric-icon { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-bg-accent-subtle, #eef6ff); color: var(--color-icon-accent, #0b3f6e); } .ds-metric-title { margin: 0; font: 400 0.875rem/1.25rem Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-text-muted, #4b5563); } .ds-metric-value { margin: 0; font: 600 1.75rem/2.25rem Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-text-default, #111827); } .ds-metric-trend { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; margin: 0; font: 500 0.8125rem/1.25rem Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-feedback-positive, #15803d); }

components.name: Demo Notice
components.description: Full-width band, first on every screen, that says the data is fictitious.
components.html: Demo con datos ficticios: no son cifras reales de Gurises Unidos y lo que cargues no se guarda.
components.css: .ds-notice { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 8px; padding: 4px 8px 4px 16px; background: var(--color-bg-accent-subtle, #eef6ff); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border-accent, #a8d6ff); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-notice-icon { flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 8px; color: var(--color-icon-accent, #0b3f6e); } .ds-notice-text { flex: 1; min-width: 0; margin: 0; padding: 6px 0; font: 400 0.875rem/1.25rem Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-text-default, #111827); } .ds-notice-close { display: flex; flex-shrink: 0; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 6px); background: transparent; color: var(--color-text-muted, #4b5563); cursor: pointer; } .ds-notice-close:hover, .ds-notice-close:focus-visible { color: var(--color-text-default, #111827); } .ds-notice-close:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus-ring, #2b7fd4); }

narrative.overview:
Every number on screen says only what it measures, and the interface gets out of its way. The surfaces are white and flat, separated by thin gray borders and white space, never by shadows. A single soft blue carries actions, focus and the informational accent; green and red appear only to report a change, and always with an arrow and a written value next to them. Typography is one family, Inter, with a large semibold figure for metrics and small, even labels around it.

The character is calm and precise: restrained surfaces, careful details. The details are where the care shows: the icon aligned with the first line of text, a focus ring on every control, states drawn on purpose instead of improvised. Density is moderate. This is a tool leadership opens to prepare a report, so scanning and consistency come before expression.
keyCharacteristics: Flat white surfaces with 1px gray borders; no shadows.
One soft blue for actions, focus and info; color never decorates data.
Trends always pair color with an arrow and text.
Inter only, six text styles, each applied as one class.
Spacing on a 4px grid; three radii plus a pill.

rules.name: The Quiet Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue is for actions, focus and information. Data never gets a decorative color; a number is Ink.

rules.name: The Color Plus Words Rule
rules.body: Green and red never travel alone: a trend carries its arrow and its written value, and a badge carries its fixed label ("Activo", "Pausado", "Error").

rules.name: The System-Only Rule
rules.body: Components use semantic colors only. A color that is not in this list does not exist yet: it is proposed, added in Figma, then exported to `app/tokens.css` (`npm run tokens`).

rules.name: The One Class Rule
rules.body: A text style is applied as one class that sets size, line height and weight together. Never rebuild one from separate size, weight and leading values.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest and stay flat on hover. A state shows through a fill or a ring, never through lift.

dos: **Do** use only the semantic tokens above, by their code names (`text-text-muted`, `bg-bg-surface`).
**Do** add a missing value as a token, in Figma first and then exported to `app/tokens.css` (`npm run tokens`).
**Do** pair every green or red with an arrow and a written value, or a fixed label.
**Do** keep secondary text at Slate or darker (at least 4.5:1).
**Do** show a 2px Signal Blue focus ring on every interactive element.
**Do** draw loading skeletons at the size of the content they replace.
donts: **Don't** use arbitrary values (`p-[22px]`, `text-[#333]`) or Tailwind's default palette, font sizes or radii: they are turned off and fail silently.
**Don't** add shadows, gradients or glows; the system is flat.
**Don't** color a number for emphasis; emphasis comes from size and weight.
**Don't** invent a logo, brand mark or brand color for Gurises Unidos.
